items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’d see a picture of [Nikita] Khrushchev, his face appearing out of a toilet.

ctx.x: You know, that’s not right. It’s not right. Um...during the the, the second world war, I’d open the mailbox and I’d see a picture of [Nikita] Khrushchev, his face appearing out of a toilet. This is supposed to make me think lesser of him, I don’t even know the man. So, stereotyping is not good, and that’s a stereotypical term. You can see by those definitions in the Merriam-Webster.
